name: dnbos-tracking-engine
description: The DnB-OS tracking engine. Node resolves module type from the NEAREST package.json, so this one file keeps the whole tree CommonJS while the repository above it is "type": "module". Without it every require() in here is read as ESM and the server dies on load. Renaming ~200 files to .cjs would have been the alternative, and would have broken the inlining tools and every internal require along with it.
